Elias placed it beside his log, lit the morning lamp, and kept watch.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市仍浸在深蓝的夜里。高楼窗灯稀疏，像未熄的星群；雨水洗过街道，霓虹在水洼里拉长。早点铺升起白汽，蒸笼里埋着第一锅温热。环卫工的扫帚划过路面，送奶车的马达远而轻。玻璃幕墙静静反射天色，一只猫掠过巷口，便利店门铃响了又静。这座城尚未醒来，却已有人点起灯火，把希望揉进拂晓。","w03":"- Think of recursion as telling a story that pauses to tell the same story again, but each time with something smaller, like nesting dolls.\n- You keep opening the smaller version until you reach the simplest one, which can be answered directly—that is the base case.\n- Then each paused story gets its answer and wraps it up, one layer at a time, until the original story is finished."}
